subject: C6d-safe LOAD regression: root cause nord2_metal_render.c:400-402 (BAD in preload block)
body: ROOT CAUSE: n2r_build_impl (gpu/metal/nord2_metal_render.c:400-402, added in 51495b8) computes sample_locations=a->frame+256 and rejects it unless within [a->command, a->command+N2R_BLOCK-256]. Legacy single-RT LOAD (bridge draw_locked, nord2_metal_bridge.c:1175) builds the preload job with pa=a; pa.command=a.command+N2R_BLOCK but pa.frame stays at block0, so frame+256 < pa.command -> n2r_build returns -1 -> draw_locked e=BAD (line 1169) before submit, no draw log line, matches xnu log (no 'draw f=80 load=1', BAD=-536870206). Lines 454/456 also write m+(sample_locations-a->command) = negative offset. Only load_action==1 non-MRT path (probe generated-quad-load). Clear/DontCare/MRT/MSAA unaffected (frame==command). MINIMAL FIX: only range-check and offset-by-command when rts->sample_locations is explicit; legacy default keeps pointer a->frame+256 and writes at m+256 (C2 behaviour). Verified in scratchpad copy (render_fix.c, production untouched): int explicit_sl=rts&&rts->sample_locations; sl_off=explicit_sl?sl-a->command:256; check only if explicit_sl; use m+sl_off at both gd_put32 loops. REPRO ALREADY EXISTS: gpu/tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c:228-237 (load=1,fault=0, n2mb_draw via fake JM) FAILS on HEAD: 'Assertion !e&&f.submitted==1... failed' (-O0 single cc build, nord2_metal_bridge_test + render.o); PASSES fully with the fix (all PASS lines through 'real TGP -> arch9 JM transport'). So tools/run_host_tests.sh bridge step was not run/failed unnoticed on C6d: gate it. Add extra assert: after load=1 draw, f.submitted==1 jobs chain has 2 jobs (preload head -> main) and FRAMEBUFFER sample_locations == block0+256. render.c sha256 prefix 337e2a4a1d0dfa15 (HEAD).
